title: 第23章 猎奇素描夹层照片第24章 准备离开
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
“这里怎么会有这种东西？”
白芑嘴里开始念叨的同时，已经从这一排最高一层的档案架上抽出了一本看起来不像是该出现在苏联境内的文学，不，摄影作品——花花公子。
在这份1987年11月份的花花公子封面上，是个漂亮的金发女郎，右下角的位置，还能看到四个蓝色的印戳——“对思想有害”、“特殊刊物”以及“不宜公开”和“政府资产”。
“有意思...”
白芑轻轻翻开这本过期许久的杂志，却发现其中有不少页似乎被裁掉了——以一种格外仔细的方式。
“你感兴趣的就是这种东西？”
虞娓娓走上来扫了一眼，带着些许没能藏好的鄙视用汉语问道。
“你不觉得好奇吗？”
白芑将手里的杂志合上，“虽然这些东西在苏联时代并不被推崇，但是有必要被送到这里来吗？”
“如果你有机会去莫斯科国立图书馆9层不对外开放的档案室，就会发现这种东西其实有很多。”
同样走过来的柳芭奇卡只是扫了眼白芑仍旧拿在手里的旧杂志便见怪不怪的同样用汉语说道，“那里简直是一座色情博物馆，里面堆积着至少一万件色情藏品。”
“真的？”白芑瞪大了眼睛。
“那些东西最早是从沙皇贵族手里抄没的，后来还有二战士兵带回来的违禁战利品，以及苏联几次对外战争的或者海外军事基地的驻军带回来的违禁品。”
虞娓娓同样见怪不怪的解释道，“还有不少是海关查获的走私品。”
“那里甚至还有满满一大箱亚戈达同志的收藏的假洋锯呢”
柳芭奇卡口无遮拦的说道，“其中有好几支还是镶钻的，据说都是从末代沙皇的妻...”
“柳芭奇卡！”虞娓娓呵斥对方的同时，已经将手电筒的强光对准了她的脸。
“你们两个怎么知道的这么清楚”
白芑目瞪口呆的问道，“还有，你刚刚说的亚戈达难道是捷尔任斯基的那位副手？古拉格大酒店的奠基人？”
“不然还能是谁？”

柳芭奇卡用手遮住虞娓娓打来的强光，“我又没有说谎，当时你明明也看到了，其中一支上面还有法贝热的签...”
“闭嘴！”
虞娓娓这次直接用手捂住了柳芭奇卡的呼吸过滤器，她现在恨不得憋死这个什么都往外说的蠢货算了。
阻止柳芭奇卡胡言乱语的同时，虞娓娓也不忘解释道，“那里不止有那些东西，还有不少苏联战后进行的一些试验的数据，我们是误打误...”
“原来是这样”
白芑看出了这个清冷姑娘的窘迫和无奈，索性将话题拉回来说道，“话虽如此，但是这些东西就算再怎么违禁，似乎也不至于藏在这种地方，除非...”
“除非什么？”
虞娓娓追问道，同时也再次瞪了柳芭奇卡一眼，深怕对方再说出什么不合时宜的蠢话。
“除非这些东西的‘不宜公开’的‘特殊刊物’和你们要找的那些胶片有同等价值。”
白芑说着，还隐晦的看了一眼不远处锁匠，他已经撬开第二个保险箱了。
“锁匠先生”
虞娓娓立刻扭头换上了俄语，“麻烦你上去看看摄影师列夫先生的情况吧。”
“没问题”
锁匠虽然听不懂白芑三人刚刚的汉语交流，但他又不是傻子，怎么会不清楚这是在支开自己呢？
正因如此，在离开7号防爆门之后，他根本就没有费力气爬上楼，反而直接钻进了6号防爆门，在从里面关死之后，重新给自己开了一瓶伏特加。
“锁匠先生是个聪明人”白芑赞叹道，“他的侄子是怎么回事？”
“失手杀死了鸡腐当地一个帮派的老大”
关上了防爆门的柳芭奇卡解释道，“无可烂没有死刑，但是让终身监禁的犯人死在监狱里的方法有很多。”
“过来帮忙吧”
白芑说着，已经将锁匠的折叠小梯子取过来，站在上面将这一层货架最顶层的所有东西都取了下来。

总得来说，这一层货架最上面的东西并不算多，三个落满了灰尘的纸箱子，一个牛皮材质的地图收纳筒，以及一摞杂志便是全部了。
将这些东西一一摆在地板上，白芑先翻了翻那些杂志。预料之中，这里装的基本上都是诸如花花公子的杂志，区别仅仅只是有的是美国版，有的是荷兰版。
content_en:
"Why is there such a thing here?"
At the same time that Bai Zhi started to mutter, he had already pulled out a book of literature, no, photography - Playboy - that didn't look like it should appear in the Soviet Union from the top shelf of the row.
On the cover of Playboy in November 1987, there is a beautiful blonde girl. In the lower right corner, you can see four blue stamps - "Harmful to Thoughts," "Special Publication," "Not For Publicity," and "Government Assets."
"Interesting..."
Bai Qi gently opened the long-outdated magazine, only to find that many pages seemed to have been cut out - in a particularly careful way.
"Is this what you're interested in?"
Yu Weiwei walked up, took a glance, and asked in Chinese with a bit of contempt that could not be hidden.
"Aren't you curious?"
Bai Qi closed the magazine in his hand, "Although these things were not respected in the Soviet era, is it necessary to send them here?"
"If you have the opportunity to go to the archives on the ninth floor of the Moscow State Library, which is not open to the public, you will find that there are actually many such things."
Lyubachka, who also came over, just glanced at the old magazine that Bai Qi still held in her hand, and said in Chinese without surprise, "That place is simply a pornographic museum, with at least 10,000 pornographic collections piled inside."
"Really?" Bai Zhi's eyes widened.
"Those things were first confiscated from the hands of the Tsarist nobles. Later, there were also contraband trophies brought back by soldiers in World War II, as well as contraband brought back by the Soviet Union's several foreign wars or garrison troops at overseas military bases."
Yu Weiwei also explained unsurprisingly, "There are also many contraband seized by customs."
"There's even a box full of fake foreign saws from Comrade Yagoda's collection."
Lyubach spoke unabashedly, "Several of them are encrusted with diamonds. It is said that they all came from the wife of the last tsar..."
"Lyubachka!" Yu Weiwei scolded the other party and pointed the bright light of the flashlight at her face.
"How do you two know so clearly?"
Bai Zhi asked dumbfounded, "Also, could the Yagoda you just mentioned be Dzerzhinsky's deputy? The founder of the Gulag Hotel?"
"Who else could it be?"
Liubachka covered the bright light from Yu Weiwei with her hands, "I didn't lie. You clearly saw it at that time. One of them had Fabergé's signature on it..."
"Shut up!"
This time Yu Weiwei directly covered Lyubachka's breathing filter with her hand. Now she wished she could suffocate this idiot who said everything to others.
While stopping Lyubachka from talking nonsense, Yu Weiwei did not forget to explain, "There are not only those things there, but also a lot of data from some experiments conducted by the Soviet Union after the war. We made a mistake..."
“So that’s how it is”
Bai Qi saw the embarrassment and helplessness of this cold girl, and simply brought the topic back and said, "Having said that, no matter how forbidden these things are, they don't seem to be hidden in a place like this, unless..."
"Unless what?"
Yu Weiwei asked, and at the same time glared at Liubachka again, fearing that the other party would say something inappropriate and stupid again.
"Unless the 'special publications' of these things are of equal value to the films you are looking for."
Bai Qi said, and glanced vaguely at the locksmith not far away. He had already pried open the second safe.
"Mr. Locksmith"
Yu Weiwei immediately turned around and spoke in Russian, "Please go up and check on Mr. Lev, the photographer."
“No problem”
Although the locksmith didn't understand the Chinese exchange between Bai Qi and the three of them, he was not a fool. How could he not know that he was being distracted?
Because of this, after leaving blast-proof door No. 7, he did notAfter struggling to climb up the stairs, he got directly into the explosion-proof door No. 6. After locking himself from the inside, he opened a bottle of vodka for himself.
"Mr. Locksmith is a smart man," Bai Zhi praised, "What's going on with his nephew?"
"Accidentally killed the boss of a local gang in Jifu"
Lyubachka, who closed the blast door, explained, "There is no death penalty, but there are many ways to make life-sentence prisoners die in prison."
"Come and help"
Bai Qi said, having already taken the locksmith's folding ladder, stood on it and took down everything from the top of the shelf.
Generally speaking, there are not many things on the top of this shelf. Three dusty cardboard boxes, a map storage tube made of cowhide, and a stack of magazines are all there.
Placing these things on the floor one by one, Bai Qi first flipped through the magazines. As expected, the stores here are basically magazines such as Playboy. The only difference is that some are American editions and some are Dutch editions.
